rules.description: Energy and cost are considered only after the safety and equipment priorities.

policy_rule.message: Dispatch priorities are pressure safety and supply assurance; compressor and equipment protection; linepack margin; flow stability; then energy and cost.

priority_order.recommendation: Priority 1: protect pressure safety and end-user supply assurance.
Priority 2: protect compressor and equipment operating boundaries; use remaining compressor regulation margin first when available.
Priority 3: restore linepack safety margin; review upstream injection or compressor strategy.
Priority 4: reduce flow fluctuation and return segments within capacity.
Priority 5: optimize energy consumption and operating cost after safety constraints are satisfied.

default_recommendation: No intervention is required; continue routine monitoring.
